title: `increase_amount()` lacks support for perpetual lock amounts
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `increase_amount()` function in the `vePeg` contract is designed to enable anyone to deposit additional tokens for any lock (`tokenId`) without modifying the unlock time. However, while this function is supposed to be compatible with both permanent and perpetual locks, **the current implementation only allows increasing the amount for non-perpetual locks**.
